name: starflask_create_job
description: Create an arbitrary Starflask job by type — the general-purpose equivalent of `npx starflask jobs create <type> --payload <json>`. Use this for job types that don't have a dedicated tool: "upscale", "remove_bg", "vectorize", "vector", "cartoonify", "clip" (media conversion), and subtypes like "image:resize", "image:crop", "image:animate", "audio:transcribe". Returns a job id immediately — poll with starflask_get_job until 'completed', then read the relevant URL from result. Most payloads follow {"structured_data": {"model_key": "<key>", "params": {...}}}; many transform jobs take an "image_url" param pointing at media you uploaded via starflask_upload_media. Prefer starflask_generate_image / _video / _3d / _speech for those four common cases.
